facts.fact: A 2024 study (cited by StackAdapt from Veeva Pulse) found that only 45% of US physicians were making themselves available to pharma companies in Q1 2024.
facts.quote: with only 45% of US physicians making themselves available to pharma companies (and 30% limiting access to just one brand)

facts.fact: The same 2024 Veeva Pulse study cited by StackAdapt found that 30% of US physicians limited access to just one pharma brand.
facts.quote: (and 30% limiting access to just one brand)

facts.fact: A National Provider Identifier (NPI) is a unique, 10-digit identification number assigned to every healthcare professional in the US.
facts.quote: a unique, 10-digit identification number assigned to every HCP in the US

facts.fact: According to an M3 MI study, the average HCP spends about 16% of their weekly professional education time reading print resources.
facts.quote: the average HCP only spends about 16% of their weekly professional education time reading print resources

facts.fact: According to M3 MI, 59% of physicians say webinars, online medical videos, and podcasts help them keep up with professional and clinical information.
facts.quote: with 59% saying these formats help them keep up with professional and clinical information

facts.fact: In the Wolters Kluwer study, 56% of physicians cite Apple Podcasts as the most-used platform for healthcare-related podcasts.
facts.quote: 56% of physicians cite Apple Podcasts as the most-used platform for healthcare-related podcasts

facts.fact: According to the Wolters Kluwer survey, 48% of HCPs say the value of sponsored content is diluted when it appears on public social media platforms.
facts.quote: with the majority (48%) saying its value is diluted when it appears on public social media platforms

facts.fact: EMARKETER reports that linear TV healthcare and pharma ad spend is expected to decline a further 10.5% in 2027.
